diagnostics.message: google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service creates a Shared VPC service-project association via the Compute API in this (service) project, but unlike its siblings (google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host, google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.service_projects, google_compute_project_metadata_item.default) it has no depends_on google_project_service.project_services. It can therefore be applied before compute.googleapis.com is enabled on the project, failing the apply. Add depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services] (no clean attribute-based data reference exists, since service_project is the project id from local.project, not from project_services).

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek has an explicit depends_on google_project.project, but its member is built from local.service_accounts_robots -> local.project.number, whose conditional (var.project_create ? google_project.project.0.number : data.google_project.project.0.number) already establishes an attribute-based edge to google_project.project. The depends_on entry is redundant.

google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek has an explicit depends_on data.google_project.project, but its member (local.service_accounts_robots) resolves local.project.number, whose non-create branch already references data.google_project.project.0.number, so the ordering is already implied by attribute reference and the depends_on is redundant.
